parameters: \bIn my haste, I didn't notice that\nI'd left you behind!
\bI've opened the locked door of\nthe Sky Pillar.
Shakes in OG go by y, x, num, delay
\bThere's not a moment to waste!\nWe've got to hurry!
\bI'm worried about Sootopolis.\nI've got to go back.
\bEverything is in your hands now.\nDon't fail us!
